material.text: dsh-ollama-statistical: DeepSeek Harness 插件：显示 Ollama Cloud 的 5 小时会话限额、周限额与官方请求量，并显示 OpenCode Go 的滚动 5 小时 / 周 / 月额度与本机 opencode CLI 的 token/费用用量；同时按供应商（provider）分类统计整个 DSH 的 token 用量（今天 / 本周周一开始 / 自定义日期，数据来自本机 DSH 会话日志），提供侧栏独立统计页与侧栏底部常驻横条。Ollama Cloud limits, OpenCode Go rolling

type=plugin source=npm:dsh-ollama-statistical created=2026-10-23T15:18:03.622Z firstSeen=2026-11-05T18:28:25.351Z published=2026-10-30T05:53:15.387Z maintainers=duanxc repoId=1431108869 stars=1 npm30d=?

# dsh-ollama-statistical **Whole-DSH token statistics + Ollama / OpenCode limits · DeepSeek Harness plugin** A dedicated sidebar statistics page plus sidebar bars: **keys are optional** — without any key you still get **whole-DSH token usage broken down by provider** by **today**, **this week (starting Monday)** and a **custom date range**; with keys configured it also shows Ollama Cloud 5-hour session and weekly limits plus official request counts, and OpenCode Go rolling 5-hour / weekly / monthly quotas plus local opencode CLI token/cost usage. [中文](README.md) · [MIT](LICENSE) [![CI](https://github.com/duanxiangchun/dsh-ollama-statistical/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/duanxiangchun/dsh-ollama-statistical/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-ollama-statistical.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-ollama-statistical)
--- ## ✨ Features | Area | What you get | | --- | --- | | **Token statistics (all providers)** | **No key required — shown by default**: **whole-DSH token usage grouped by provider**: provider filter chips (with per-provider range totals), merged or per-provider model lists, and three views: **today**, **this week (Monday → today)**, **custom range**. **Every metric (totals, input/output/cached tokens (cache-write/reasoning cards appear only when the provider reports them), requests, active days, sessions, provider shares and model lists) is scoped to the selected range**, plus a multi-series SVG trend chart (Input / Output / Cache Read / cache hit rate with a right-hand percent axis; 24 hourly points for today, daily points for week/custom) | | **Optional keys** | Ollama / OpenCode keys are **both optional**: without a key the page shows only local token statistics and hides that provider's limits, official request counts, local OpenCode CLI usage and sidebar row — no “not configured” placeholder either (with neither key the whole limits section is not rendered). Keys are reused automatically from the DSH credential store / environment / CLI login; the header's “Configure keys” button adds them later, and configured providers can still change / clear keys in the limits section at the top of the page; OpenCode also supports “Remove key” (plugin-level disable, see below) | | **Display toggles (Ollama / OpenCode)** | “Visibility” toggles in the page header (Ollama / OpenCode, both on by default): show only one provider's limits, official request counts, local OpenCode CLI usage and sidebar row; turning one off only **hides** that provider — it **does not delete the key**, and turning it back on restores the sections immediately; the token statistics (all providers) section always shows every provider and is not affected. Unlike “Remove key”, a toggle never changes whether a key is used | | **Ollama limits** | **Shown after configuring an Ollama key**: Ollama Cloud **5-hour session limit** and **weekly limit**: used/remaining percent, progress bar and reset countdown (official `GET /api/balance`) ; the weekly quota is also **estimated in tokens** (local Ollama token usage ÷ official used percent) | | **Ollama official request counts** | **Only shown after configuring an Ollama key**: request counts for **today** / **this week (UTC Monday onward)** / **this month (UTC 1st onward)** from the official `GET /api/usage`, with sparklines (day/week/month re-filtered from official hour/day buckets at UTC day boundaries, matching the official quota cycles) | | **OpenCode Go limits** | **Shown after configuring an OpenCode key**: OpenCode Go subscription **rolling 5-hour / weekly / monthly** quotas: used/remaining percent, progress bar and reset countdown (official `GET /zen/go/v1/usage`). The official API only returns **used percent + reset time** — no money or absolute token figures; **Zen pay-as-you-go (PAYG) has no official quota API**, so cost is only visible in the OpenCode console. The three cards also show a **token estimate** (estimated total / used / remaining, same basis as the Ollama weekly card: local window usage ÷ official used percent; local CLI only, other clients are not counted, low when history is incomplete, and the rolling 5h window is approximated by the last 5 local hourly buckets; **an estimate only, not the official quota** — official percentages and reset times still come from the API) | | **Local OpenCode CLI usage** | **Only shown after configuring an OpenCode key and with the header “Visibility” toggle on** (and requires **Node ≥22.5** / `node:sqlite`): token and cost statistics from the local `opencode.db` in **three cards for today / this week / this month**: total tokens, cost, requests, input / cache read / output, plus a sparkline (24 local hours for today, daily points for week / month) and the date range; kept separate from the **Token statistics (all providers)** scope based on DSH session logs; its window usage also feeds the OpenCode quota token estimate | | **Remove key (OpenCode)** | When OpenCode is configured (whatever the source: manual, DSH credential, environment variable or opencode CLI login), a “Remove key” button appears at the right of the limits-section title: clicking it makes the plugin stop using that key (including the DSH credential, environment variables and the opencode CLI login), so the OpenCode limits, local CLI usage and sidebar row are hidden. The plugin makes a **best-effort deletion of the DSH credential record** but **does not delete environment variables or the opencode CLI login file** (still managed by external tools); afterwards use “Restore external key” in the header “Configure keys” panel, or paste a new key (restores automatically). Header display toggles only hide sections; they do not remove the key | | **Sidebar bars** | Only rows for enabled providers with data appear: with an Ollama key and available limits, session (5h, amber) + weekly (teal-green); when OpenCode Go data exists, an extra **OpenCode summary** row (largest used percent across the three windows); when there is no row the whole bar is not rendered. Reset countdown and last update in the tooltip, refreshed every 60 s | | **Statistics page** | “Token stats” entry in the left sidebar opens the full page (page title “Token stats”); light/dark themes, narrow-screen layout, keyboard accessible | | **Zero dependencies** | Host uses Node built-ins only; Client only `require('react')`, no build step | ## 🔍 Data sources and scope (important) Local token statistics (item 3) **need no key**; items 1, 2 and 4 are only requested and shown when the corresponding provider has a key configured, and item 5 is only shown with an OpenCode key (reading the local DB does not need the network). 1. **Limits** come from `https://ollama.com/api/balance`. Legacy plans with session/weekly limits return `included.session|weekly.remaining_percent + resets_at`; credit-based plans return `included.balance_usd / allowance_usd / period` and the page shows the subscription allowance instead. 2. **Official request counts** come from `https://ollama.com/api/usage?range=24h|7d|30d`. For **legacy plans the official API only returns `request_count`, no token figures** (an API limitation, not a missing feature). Any token/usage_usd fields that appear later are passed through. Official data is bucketed by **UTC** hour/day and covers **all clients** of the account, not only this machine. The API only offers rolling 24h/7d/30d windows; the plugin re-filters their hour/day buckets to **today / this week (UTC Monday onward) / this month (UTC 1st onward) → now** — exactly aligned with the official buckets, and the official weekly quota resets at UTC Monday 00:00, so "this week" is the current official quota cycle. 3. **Token statistics (default view, no key needed)** are computed from **local DSH session logs** (`usage` on `assistant/message` events) **across all providers** (grouped by the event's `provider`/`model`, i.e. the ollama / sub / mgdaas / wb … ids configured in DSH), bucketed by **local-timezone** days (week starts Monday). Ollama limits and official request counts still target only the `OLLAMA_API_KEY` account; the official request count also includes other clients, so the two are shown side by side for reference. **Archived sessions are included** (archiving is only a workspace view flag), and **deleting a session does not shrink the numbers**: the plugin keeps the deleted session's per-day token contribution in a local ledger (`$DSH_HOME/storages/ollama-statistical/ledger.json`) and marks it as "includes N deleted sessions". Delete that ledger file to clear it (then only existing sessions are counted). A few unreadable session logs are reported as "N sessions could not be read"; opening each session once in DSH triggers migration and the numbers fill in automatically (the plugin retries every 6 hours). 4. **OpenCode Go limits** come from `https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage` (`Authorization: Bearer `). The official API only returns **used percent + reset time** for `rolling` / `weekly` / `monthly`; there is no money or absolute token figure and **Zen pay-as-you-go (PAYG) has no official quota API** — cost is only visible in the OpenCode console. **OpenCode also has no official cost / request-count API**: the local opencode CLI cost and request counts below come from the local database and do not represent account totals. Keys are reused from the opencode CLI login file `~/.local/share/opencode/auth.json` (`opencode-go.key`, then `opencode.key`), or pasted in the page (a manual key wins). The cards also show a **token estimate** (estimated total / used / remaining) on the same basis as the Ollama weekly card: local opencode.db usage for the matching window (this week / this month / the last 5 local hourly buckets) divided by the official used percent. Note: only the local opencode CLI is counted, other clients are not; the estimate is low when history is incomplete; the rolling 5h window is approximated by the last 5 local hourly buckets; **it is an estimate, not the official quota** — official percentages and reset times still come from the API. 5. **Local OpenCode CLI usage** comes from `~/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db` (SQLite, opened **read-only** with Node's built-in `node:sqlite`; Node 20 lacks that module, so this section is hidden there). It sums `role==='assistant'` messages from the last 30 days, bucketed by **local-timezone** days (week starts Monday, month on the 1st), with an extra 24-hour local-time bucket set for today; it uses each record's `cost` (USD), with a top-10 model list grouped by `provider/model`. Override the path with `OPENCODE_DB_PATH` (default `~/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db`, then `%LOCALAPPDATA%/opencode/opencode.db`). The section renders **three cards for today / this week / this month** (today's sparkline uses the 24-hour buckets, week / month use daily buckets). Its window usage also feeds the OpenCode quota estimate above. These numbers are **never mixed** with the DSH token statistics in item 3. ## 📦 Install ```bash # from npm, once published: dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-ollama-statistical # local development (this repository is the package root): # plugin_manager install_bundle with target = this directory (linked into the profile) dsh --profile desktop ``` After installing, **refresh the DSH Web page** (or restart DSH) to load the client bundle; the Host side is live immediately. A “Token stats” entry appears in the left sidebar. Without any key the page shows local token statistics by default (no limits section, no sidebar bars); after configuring an Ollama / OpenCode key, the corresponding limits, official request counts and local OpenCode CLI usage appear. ## 🚀 Usage 1. Click the “Token stats” icon in the left sidebar: **no key is required** — the page shows provider-grouped token statistics from local DSH session logs by default; 2. To see Ollama / OpenCode limits, click the “Configure keys” button in the page header (visible while at least one provider is unconfigured) and add the missing key(s) in the panel that opens (Ollama and OpenCode can both be configured); saving goes through the existing checks (`/api/balance` for Ollama, `/zen/go/v1/usage` for OpenCode); 3. Ollama key: create one at [ollama.com/settings/keys](https://ollama.com/settings/keys) and paste it, or configure `OLLAMA_API_KEY` for the Ollama provider in DSH settings (the plugin reuses it automatically); 4. OpenCode reuses the opencode CLI login key by default; if that key has expired (the page shows a 401 / invalid-key message such as `api_key_expired`), recreate it in the [OpenCode Console](https://opencode.ai/auth) and paste it via “Configure keys / Change key”; with a Go subscription the three quota windows show percentages and reset countdowns; without a subscription or on fetch failure an empty / error state explains why (the last successful data is kept; use “Refresh” to retry); 5. Configured providers can still change / clear their key from the header of the limits section at the top of the page; 6. Use the “Visibility” toggles in the page header (Ollama / OpenCode, both on by default) to show only one provider's sections: turning one off only hides that provider's limits, official request counts, local OpenCode CLI usage and sidebar row — it **does not delete or disable the key**, and turning it back on restores them immediately; the token statistics (all providers) section always shows every provider and is not affected; 7. When OpenCode is configured, use the “Remove key” button at the right of that section title (it affects OpenCode only, not Ollama): the plugin stops using that key (including the DSH credential, environment variables and the opencode CLI login), so the OpenCode limits, local CLI usage and sidebar row are hidden. The plugin makes a best-effort deletion of the DSH credential record but **does not delete environment variables or the opencode CLI login file** (still managed by external tools). Afterwards use “Restore external key” in the header “Configure keys” panel, or paste a new key (restores automatically); 8. Use the `Today` / `This week` / `Custom` tabs for token statistics; 9. Opening the page is always instant: `snapshot` serves stale-while-revalidate — any existing snapshot (including the on-disk one after a restart) is returned immediately while a background refetch refreshes it (the page picks up new data in ~10 s). `Refresh` forces a refetch (15 s throttle; official API allows 10 req/min). **Key precedence** (once a key is configured) Without any key no official request is made; the order below only picks between multiple configured sources. For OpenCode, using “Remove key” on the page disables all of the sources below until “Restore external key” is used or a new key is pasted. - **OpenCode** (high → low): a manual key in the page (“Configure keys” / “Change key”, **highest** — overrides an expired CLI key) → DSH credentials `OPENCODE_API_KEY` / `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY` → environment → opencode CLI login (`opencode-go.key`, then `opencode.key` in `~/.local/share/opencode/auth.json`). “Clear manual key” falls back to the remaining sources. - **Ollama** keeps its existing order: DSH credential store → environment → legacy Ollama CLI login → a manual key in the page. > **First run**: the plugin scans the last 30 days of local DSH session logs in background rounds; the page shows > "filling in historical sessions x/y" and 500+ sessions converge in about 2–4 minutes (one background round has a > 180 s budget and continues in the next round; `snapshot` keeps returning in milliseconds meanwhile). Later cold > starts are instant from the local cache (everyday opens too: SWR returns the existing snapshot > immediately while the background refetches); only new sessions need scanning. > **No key required**: token statistics come entirely from local session logs and need no Ollama / OpenCode key; the > limits sections and sidebar bars appear only after the corresponding key is configured. ## 🔒 Privacy - Keys stay local: the DSH credential store and opencode CLI login files are reused; a pasted key (Ollama or OpenCode) is stored in `$DSH_HOME/storages/ollama-statistical/state.json` (POSIX mode 600; on Windows it relies on the `$DSH_HOME` user-directory ACL and the plugin best-effort tightens it to the current user with `icacls`) and can be cleared from the page; - “Remove key” only makes the plugin stop using the key and best-effort deletes the DSH credential record; it **does not modify or delete environment variables, `opencode.db` or the opencode CLI login file** (`~/.local/share/opencode/auth.json`, still managed by external tools); - Network requests go only to `https://ollama.com` (`/api/balance`, `/api/usage`) and `https://opencode.ai` (`/zen/go/v1/usage`); - **Without any key no network request is made**: token statistics come entirely from local session logs and need no key; - Token and cost aggregation is local and never leaves the machine; `opencode.db` is opened read-only and never written; - **The full key (Ollama or OpenCode) is never sent to the browser**; only a masked form such as `sk-****1fdd` is shown. ## 🏗️ Architecture ``` ┌───────────────────────────────┐ ┌──────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ browser (lib/client.js) │ RPC │ host (lib/index.js) │ │ · statistics page (main) │◄──────►│ · webServer route /ollama-statistical │ │ · sidebar footer bars │envelope│ · /api/balance + /api/usage (60 s cache) │ │ · OpenCode quota / local CLI │ │ · /zen/go/v1/usage + opencode.db (RO) │ │ · panel icon, i18n, themes │ │ · key resolve / state.json / cache │ └───────────────────────────────┘ └──────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` - RPC: `POST /ollama-statistical/` with `{type:'client-request',rpcId,method,payload}`; - Endpoints: `snapshot` / `refresh` / `auth-state` / `set-key` / `clear-key`; - Keys are optional: with neither key, `snapshot` still succeeds (local token statistics with empty limits / official) instead of returning `no-key` / `no-data`; - Contract: .dev/protocol.md in the repository (development document, not published). ## 🧩 Compatibility | DSH | Status | | --- | --- | | 0.2.1-rc.3 | ✅ tested (Node 22.22, Windows, v0.8 OpenCode quotas / local usage; v0.9 optional keys / default token statistics; v0.9.1 remove key; v0.9.2 display toggles; v0.9.3 local-usage cards; v0.9.4 quota estimates) | | 0.2.1-rc.2 | ✅ tested (Node 22.22, Windows; v0.7 and earlier) | Node `>=20`; **local OpenCode CLI usage requires Node `>=22.5`** (`node:sqlite`; on Node 20 that section is hidden and everything else works). DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.1`. Host services used: `webServer`, `timer`, `credentials`, `sessionQuery`. ## 🛠️ Development ```bash node --check lib/index.js node --check lib/client.js npm test # node --test: parsing / aggregation / envelope / key precedence / scan budget / OpenCode node --test test/opencode.test.mjs # OpenCode only: usage parsing / key precedence / local DB (sqlite cases skip on Node 20) node .dev/verify-rpc.mjs # live envelope + shape + secret-leak probe (skips when the running host has no opencode field) ``` > Installed from a local directory as a `link:`, the plugin's Host module is not reloaded by HMR: after editing > `lib/index.js`, disable and re-enable the bundle in the plugin manager; after editing `lib/client.js`, just > refresh the page. ## 📄 License [MIT](LICENSE)

# dsh-ollama-statistical **整个 DSH 的 Token 统计 + Ollama / OpenCode 限额 · DeepSeek Harness 插件** 侧栏独立统计页 + 侧栏底部横条：**Key 可选**——不配置 Key 也能看**整个 DSH 按供应商分类**的 token 用量 （今天 / 本周（周一开始）/ 自定义日期）；配置 Key 后额外显示 Ollama Cloud 的 5 小时会话限额、 周限额与官方请求量，以及 OpenCode Go 的滚动 5 小时 / 周 / 月额度与本机 opencode CLI 的 token/费用用量。 [English](README.en.md) · [MIT](LICENSE) [![CI](https://github.com/duanxiangchun/dsh-ollama-statistical/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/duanxiangchun/dsh-ollama-statistical/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-ollama-statistical.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-ollama-statistical)
--- ## ✨ 功能 | 区域 | 内容 | | --- | --- | | **Token 统计（全部供应商）** | **无需 Key，默认显示**：**整个 DSH 的 token 用量，按供应商（provider）分类**：供应商筛选 chips（含各供应商范围合计）、合并/单供应商模型榜；三视图 **今天** / **本周（周一开始 → 今天）** / **自定义日期区间**；**所有指标（总/输入/输出/缓存读写/推理、缓存命中率（有缓存读时才显示）、请求数、活跃天数、会话数、供应商分布、模型榜）都按所选时间范围统计**，多序列趋势图（Input / Output / Cache Read / 缓存命中率，今天按 24 小时、本周与自定义按天，右轴为命中率百分比） | | **Key 可选** | Ollama / OpenCode 的 Key **都不是必填项**：不配置时页面只显示本地 token 统计，该 provider 的限额、官方请求量、本机 OpenCode CLI 用量与侧栏行自动隐藏，也不显示「未配置」占位（两个 Key 都没有时限额区整体不渲染）；会自动复用 DSH 凭证 / 环境变量 / CLI 登录，页面头部「配置 Key」可随时补配；已配置后仍可在页面上方的限额区更换 / 清除 Key；OpenCode 还支持「移除 Key」（插件级停用，见下） | | **显示开关（Ollama / OpenCode）** | 页头「显示范围」有两个开关（Ollama / OpenCode，默认都开）：可只显示其中一个 provider 的限额、官方请求量、本机 OpenCode CLI 用量与侧栏行；关闭只是**隐藏显示**，**不会删除 Key**，重新打开立即恢复；「Token 统计（全部供应商）」区始终显示全部供应商，不受开关影响。与「移除 Key」不同：开关不改变 Key 的使用状态 | | **Ollama 限额** | **配置 Ollama Key 后显示**：Ollama Cloud 的 **5 小时会话限额** 与 **周限额**：已用 / 剩余百分比、进度条、重置倒计时（来自官方 `GET /api/balance`）；周限额另有 **token 额度估算**（用本机 Ollama token 用量 ÷ 已用百分比反推总量/已用/剩余） | | **Ollama 官方请求量** | **仅在配置 Ollama Key 后显示**：官方 `GET /api/usage` 的 **今天** / **本周（UTC 周一起）** / **本月（UTC 1 日起）**请求数（含 sparkline；今天/周/月由官方小时/日桶按 UTC 日界重过滤，与官方配额周期一致） | | **OpenCode Go 限额** | **配置 OpenCode Key 后显示**：OpenCode Go 订阅的**滚动 5 小时 / 本周 / 本月**额度：已用 / 剩余百分比、进度条、重置倒计时（来自官方 `GET /zen/go/v1/usage`）。官方只提供**已用百分比 + 重置时间**，没有金额或绝对 token；**Zen 按量计费（PAYG）没有官方额度接口**，金额只在 OpenCode 控制台可见。三张卡另显示 **token 估算**（估算总量 / 已用 / 剩余，口径同 Ollama 周卡：本机对应窗口用量 ÷ 官方已用百分比；仅本机 CLI、其它客户端不计、历史不全时偏小，滚动 5h 用最近 5 个本机小时桶近似；**只是估算，不是官方额度**，官方百分比 / 重置时间仍以 API 为准） | | **本机 OpenCode CLI 用量** | **仅在配置 OpenCode Key 且页头「显示开关」打开时显示**（且需要 **Node ≥22.5** / `node:sqlite`）：从本机 `opencode.db` 统计 opencode CLI 用量，**今天 / 本周 / 本月三张卡片**：总 token、费用、请求数、输入 / 缓存读 / 输出，以及 sparkline（今天按本机 24 小时，本周 / 本月按天）与日期范围；与「Token 统计（全部供应商）」的 DSH 会话日志口径不同，分开显示；同一窗口用量也用于 OpenCode 额度卡的 token 估算 | | **移除 Key（OpenCode）** | OpenCode 已配置时（无论 Key 来自手动、DSH 凭证、环境变量还是 opencode CLI 登录），页面上方限额区标题右侧显示「移除 Key」按钮：点击后插件不再使用该 Key（包括 DSH 凭证、环境变量、opencode CLI 登录），OpenCode 限额、本机 CLI 用量与侧栏行随之隐藏。插件会**尽力删除 DSH 凭证记录**，但**不会删除环境变量或 opencode CLI 登录文件**（仍由外部工具管理）；之后可在页头「配置 Key」面板点「恢复外部 Key」，或直接粘贴新 Key（自动恢复）。页头显示开关只隐藏显示、不移除 Key | | **侧栏底部横条** | 只显示显示开关已打开且确有数据的数据行：配置 Ollama Key 且限额可用时显示会话 5h（琥珀）+ 本周（青绿）；有 OpenCode Go 数据时追加一行 OpenCode 汇总（取三个窗口已用百分比最大者）；一行都没有时整条横条不显示。悬停看重置倒计时与更新时间，每 60 秒自动刷新 | | **独立统计页** | 左侧栏「Token 统计」入口 → 完整统计页（页面标题「Token 统计」）；亮/暗主题、窄屏自适应、键盘可达 | | **零依赖** | Host 只用 Node 内建能力；Client 只 `require('react')`，无构建步骤 | ## 🔍 数据来源与口径（重要） 本机 token 统计（第 3 条）**不需要任何 Key**；第 1、2、4 条只在对应 provider 配置了 Key 时才会请求与显示，第 5 条仅在配置 OpenCode Key 后显示（本机 DB 读取本身不依赖网络）。 1. **限额**：`https://ollama.com/api/balance`。带 5h/周限额的 legacy 套餐返回 `included.session|weekly.remaining_percent + resets_at`，插件换算成已用百分比并原样透传重置时间； 余额制套餐返回 `included.balance_usd / allowance_usd / period`，此时页面显示订阅额度。 2. **官方请求数**：`https://ollama.com/api/usage?range=24h|7d|30d`。 官方对 **legacy 套餐只返回 `request_count`，不返回 token 数**（这是接口限制，不是插件缺功能）； 接口若某天返回 token / usage_usd 字段，插件会如实展示。官方数据 **按 UTC 小时/日归集**， 且统计该账号下**所有客户端**，不限于本机。接口只有滚动 24h/7d/30d 窗口，插件把其小时/日桶按 **今天 / 本周（UTC 周一起）/ 本月（UTC 1 日起）→ 现在** 重过滤后展示——窗口与官方桶严格对齐， 且官方周限额就在 UTC 周一 00:00 重置，「本周」即当前官方配额周期。 3. **Token 统计（默认视图，不需要 Key）**：来自**本机 DSH 会话日志**（`assistant/message` 事件的 `usage`）， **统计全部供应商**（按事件里的 `provider` / `model` 分类，即你在 DSH 设置里配置的 ollama / sub / mgdaas / wb …）， 按**本机时区**的日界聚合（周一开始）。Ollama 限额与官方请求数仍只针对 `OLLAMA_API_KEY` 账号； 官方页面上的请求数还包含你在其它客户端的用量，与本机 DSH 统计口径不同，两者并排展示可互相参照。**归档会话也计入**（归档只是工作区视图标记，不改日志）； **删除会话后数字也不缩水**：插件会把已消失会话的 per-day token 贡献保存在本地账本 `$DSH_HOME/storages/ollama-statistical/ledger.json`，继续计入并标注「含 N 个已删除会话」； 删除该账本文件即可清空（此后只统计现存会话）。个别日志读取失败的会话会提示「N 个会话日志读取失败」， 在 DSH 里打开一次对应会话触发迁移后会自动补上（插件每 6 小时重试）。 4. **OpenCode Go 限额**：`https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage`（`Authorization: Bearer `）。 官方只返回**已用百分比 + 重置时间**（`rolling` / `weekly` / `monthly`），没有金额或绝对 token； **Zen 按量计费（PAYG）没有官方额度接口**，金额只在 OpenCode 控制台可见。 **OpenCode 也没有官方的金额 / 请求量统计接口**——本机 opencode CLI 的金额与请求数来自下一条的本地数据库， 不代表账号总额。Key 默认复用 opencode CLI 登录文件 `~/.local/share/opencode/auth.json` （`opencode-go.key`，其次 `opencode.key`），也可在页面手动粘贴（手动 Key 优先）。 卡片还会显示 **token 估算**（估算总量 / 已用 / 剩余），口径与 Ollama 周卡估算一致：用**本机 opencode.db** 在对应窗口（本周 / 本月 / 最近 5 个本机小时桶）的 token 用量 ÷ 官方已用百分比反推。注意：只统计本机 opencode CLI，其它客户端不计入；历史统计不完整时估算偏小；滚动 5h 用最近 5 个本机小时桶近似； **估算不是官方额度**——官方百分比与重置时间仍以 API 返回为准。 5. **本机 OpenCode CLI 用量**：`~/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db`（SQLite，仅用 Node 内建 `node:sqlite`， **只读打开、绝不写库**；Node 20 没有该模块，此时该区域不显示）。统计最近 30 天内 `role==='assistant'` 的消息，按**本机时区**日界聚合（周一开始、月从 1 日起），今天另外按本机小时聚合成 24 个小时桶； 金额取记录里的 `cost`（USD），模型榜按 `provider/model` 取 top 10。路径可用 `OPENCODE_DB_PATH` 覆盖（默认 `~/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db`，其次 `%LOCALAPPDATA%/opencode/opencode.db`）。 页面以**今天 / 本周 / 本月三张卡片**展示（今天 sparkline 用 24 小时桶，本周 / 本月按天）， 其窗口用量也用于上一条的 OpenCode 额度估算；这部分与上面第 3 条的 DSH token 统计**互不混算**。 ## 📦 安装 ```bash # 发布到 npm 后： dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-ollama-statistical # 本地目录开发（本仓库即插件包根目录）： # plugin_manager install_bundle，target 指向本目录（会被 link 进 profile） dsh --profile desktop ``` 安装后**刷新 DSH Web 页面**（或重启 DSH）加载前端 bundle；Host 侧即时生效。左侧栏出现「Token 统计」入口， 未配置 Key 时页面默认显示本地 token 统计（不显示限额区与侧栏横条）；配置 Ollama / OpenCode Key 后， 对应限额、官方请求量与本机 OpenCode CLI 用量才会出现。 ## 🚀 使用 1. 点左侧栏的「Token 统计」图标进入统计页：**无需配置 Key**，默认显示本机 DSH 会话日志聚合的按供应商 token 统计； 2. 需要看 Ollama / OpenCode 限额时，点页面头部的「配置 Key」按钮（至少一个 provider 未配置时可见）， 在展开的面板里为未配置的 provider 补配 Key（可同时配置 Ollama / OpenCode）；保存走既有校验 （Ollama `/api/balance`，OpenCode `/zen/go/v1/usage`）； 3. 配置 Ollama Key：按页面引导在 [ollama.com/settings/keys](https://ollama.com/settings/keys) 创建后粘贴检测， 也可以先在 DSH 设置里给 Ollama provider 配好 `OLLAMA_API_KEY`（插件自动复用）； 4. OpenCode 默认复用 opencode CLI 登录的 Key；若本机 Key 已过期（页面提示 401 / Key 失效，如 `api_key_expired`）， 到 [OpenCode Console](https://opencode.ai/auth) 重新创建后，在页面的「配置 Key / 更换 Key」粘贴即可； 有 Go 订阅时显示三个窗口的百分比与重置倒计时；没有订阅或获取失败时显示空态 / 错误提示 （保留上次成功数据，点「刷新」重试）； 5. 已配置的 provider 仍可在页面上方限额区标题右侧更换 / 清除 Key； 6. 页头的「显示范围」开关（Ollama / OpenCode，默认都开）可只显示其中一个 provider 的对应区块：关闭只是隐藏该 provider 的 限额、官方请求量、本机 OpenCode CLI 用量与侧栏行，**不会删除或停用 Key**，重新打开立即恢复； 「Token 统计（全部供应商）」区始终显示全部供应商，不受开关影响； 7. OpenCode 已配置时，可在该区标题右侧点「移除 Key」（只影响 OpenCode，不影响 Ollama）：插件不再使用该 Key（包括 DSH 凭证、环境变量、 opencode CLI 登录），OpenCode 限额、本机 CLI 用量与侧栏行随之隐藏；插件会尽力删除 DSH 凭证记录， 但**不会删除环境变量或 opencode CLI 登录文件**（这些仍归外部工具管理）。之后可在页头「配置 Key」面板 点「恢复外部 Key」，或直接粘贴新 Key（自动恢复）； 8. `今天` / `本周` / `自定义` 三个 tab 查看 token 统计； 9. 打开页面永远秒开：`snapshot` 采用 stale-while-revalidate——只要手上有快照（含重启后的磁盘缓存） 就立即返回，数据过期时后台自动重采、页面约 10 秒后自动换新，绝不前台卡等网络或日志扫描； 顶部「刷新」强制立即重取（15s 节流；官方接口限流 10 次/分钟）。 **Key 优先级**（配置 Key 后） 不配置 Key 时不会触发对应官方请求；以下顺序只用于已存在多个来源时选择。 对 OpenCode 而言，在页面「移除 Key」后上述所有来源都会停用，直到点「恢复外部 Key」或粘贴新 Key。 - **OpenCode**（高 → 低）：页面手动 Key（「更换 Key」/「配置 Key」，**最高**，可覆盖已过期的 CLI Key）→ DSH 凭证 `OPENCODE_API_KEY` / `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY` → 环境变量 → opencode CLI 登录 （`~/.local/share/opencode/auth.json` 的 `opencode-go.key`，其次 `opencode.key`）；「清除手动 Key」后回退到后续来源。 - **Ollama** 保持原有顺序：DSH 凭证库 → 环境变量 → 旧版 Ollama CLI 登录 → 页面手动 Key。 > **首次使用**：插件会在后台分轮扫描本机最近 30 天的 DSH 会话日志，页面显示「正在补齐历史会话 x/y」， > 本机 500+ 会话约 2~4 分钟补齐（单轮后台预算 180s，未补完会自动接下一轮；期间 `snapshot` 仍在毫秒级返回已有数据）； > 之后冷启动靠本地缓存秒开（日常打开亦然：SWR 旧快照立即返回 + 后台自动补新），只有新增会话需要补扫。 > **无 Key 也能用**：token 统计完全来自本机会话日志，不需要 Ollama / OpenCode Key；限额区与侧栏横条只在配置对应 Key 后出现。 ## 🔒 隐私 - Key 只在本机：优先复用 DSH 凭证库与 opencode CLI 登录文件，手动 Key（Ollama / OpenCode）明文存储于 `$DSH_HOME/storages/ollama-statistical/state.json`（POSIX 模式 600；Windows 上依赖 `$DSH_HOME` 用户目录 ACL，插件写入后尽力用 `icacls` 收紧到当前用户），可随时在页面清除； - 页面「移除 Key」只让插件停用该 Key 并尽力删除 DSH 凭证记录，**不会修改或删除环境变量、opencode.db 或 opencode CLI 登录文件**（`~/.local/share/opencode/auth.json` 仍由外部工具管理）； - 网络请求只发往 `https://ollama.com`（`/api/balance`、`/api/usage`）与 `https://opencode.ai` （`/zen/go/v1/usage`）； - **不配置 Key 时不会发起任何网络请求**：token 统计完全来自本机会话日志，不需要 Key； - Token 与费用统计完全在本机聚合，不外发；`opencode.db` 以只读模式打开，绝不写库； - **完整 Key（Ollama / OpenCode）永远不会返回给浏览器端**，页面只显示 `sk-****1fdd` 形态的掩码。 ## 🏗️ 架构 ``` ┌───────────────────────────────┐ ┌──────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ browser (lib/client.js) │ RPC │ host (lib/index.js) │ │ · 侧栏统计页（main） │◄──────►│ · webServer 路由 /ollama-statistical │ │ · 侧栏底部横条 │ 信封协议 │ · /api/balance + /api/usage（60s 缓存） │ │ · OpenCode 限额 / 本机用量 │ │ · /zen/go/v1/usage + opencode.db（只读） │ │ · 面板图标、i18n、主题 │ │ · key 解析 / state.json / 会话缓存 │ └───────────────────────────────┘ └──────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` - RPC：`POST /ollama-statistical/`，信封 `{type:'client-request',rpcId,method,payload}`； - 端点：`snapshot` / `refresh` / `auth-state` / `set-key` / `clear-key`； - Key 可选：两个 Key 都缺失时 `snapshot` 仍返回成功（只含本地 token 统计与空 limits / official），不再返回 `no-key` / `no-data`； -
